content.default_answer: If this does not answer your question, please find a SnT2025 Staff member that you will recognize by their different coloured Badge or find the Point of Contact or Registration Desk on the ground floor.
content.venue_overview: SnT2025 will take place for the 5th time in Hofburg Palace Vienna. As the former residence of the Habsburg dynasty, the Hofburg provides a unique atmosphere steeped in history, culture, and architectural elegance.

entrance_and_foyer.description: You have entered through the conference entrance into the Foyer. After crossing the security and passing by the registration desk on the left, you will find the cloakroom Point of Contact for Questions you might have on the right.
entrance_and_foyer.navigation: You will find guiding signs and the program of the conference throughout the area. All presentation spaces have a color coding that will help you identify the right room for each part of the program.

exhibitor_space.location: On the ground floor to the left after registration
features: Exhibitor booths run by partner institutions and companies

ground_floor.accessibility: The barrier free elevator to the upper level you will find at the end of the exhibition space in Gardehalle I to the right.

additional_facilities.toilets: Located to the right on the base of the Feststiege - the stairs towards the upper level of the conference area
additional_facilities.special_rooms: To the left you will find the nursing room as well as the prayer room

stair_top_area.description: On the top of the stairs you will find another exhibitor space
booths: NDCs4All Information booth (includes a post station where you can write messages from the SnT2025)

upper_level.accessibility: The barrier free elevator you will again find at the end of the hallway called Seitenhalle to the right.

content.navigation_notes: Again all rooms have a corresponding color coding with the program. Each room is clearly marked with the corresponding color coding, consistent with the program schedule.

festsaal.description: The main conference hall located on the mezzanine level within the red-outlined SnT2025 conference zone. Grand imperial space with high ceilings and formal architectural elements.
festsaal.layout: Mixed theater-style and flexible seating arrangements
festsaal.navigation_from_entry: Left 15m to Feststiege → up stairs (20-25 steps) → straight 20m → large double doors on left
festsaal.door_details: Heavy carved wooden double doors with brass fittings, handles at 1.2m height, requires firm pull to open
festsaal.room_characteristics: Grand imperial hall with high ceilings and formal architectural elements
accessibility_features: Reserved front seating for assistive devices
tactile_landmarks: Heavy door weight and brass fittings

prinz_eugen_saal.description: Large presentation hall located at the far end of the ground floor exhibition area. Named after Prince Eugene of Savoy, this room maintains classical Habsburg architectural elements.
prinz_eugen_saal.navigation_from_kiosk: Turn left → walk 25m to exhibition area → continue straight 50m to far end
prinz_eugen_saal.door_details: Large wooden double doors with brass handles at 1.1m height
prinz_eugen_saal.acoustic_profile: Moderate reverberation, suitable for technical presentations
notable_events: Technical oral sessions O3.1, O3.5, O4.4
tactile_landmarks: Floor transition from carpet to marble at entrance
Large door size distinguishes from smaller rooms

forum.description: Medium-sized conference room with flexible seating arrangement, located on the right side of the ground floor exhibition area.
forum.navigation_from_kiosk: Turn left → walk 25m to exhibition area → turn right 20m → standard door entrance
forum.door_details: Standard width door, wood veneer finish, push-to-open mechanism
forum.acoustic_profile: Low reverberation, optimized for oral presentations and Q&A sessions
tactile_landmarks: Standard door distinguishes from larger Prinz Eugen Saal

wintergarten.description: Seminar-style conference room with large windows providing natural lighting. The name reflects its garden-facing orientation within the palace complex.
wintergarten.navigation_from_kiosk: Follow route to Festsaal → continue past Festsaal 15m → next major door on left
wintergarten.door_details: Standard conference room entrance, moderate width
wintergarten.acoustic_profile: Moderate reverberation, excellent for presentations and workshops
accessibility_features: Natural lighting beneficial for low-vision users
tactile_landmarks: Possible warmth from window solar gain

zeremoniensaal.description: Ceremonial hall on the mezzanine level within the SnT2025 conference zone. Formal presentation space with traditional Habsburg architectural elements.
zeremoniensaal.layout: Formal ceremonial hall with flexible presentation arrangements
zeremoniensaal.navigation_from_entry: Left 15m to Feststiege → up stairs → right 15m to ceremonial entrance
zeremoniensaal.door_details: Large ceremonial doorway with formal entrance characteristics
zeremoniensaal.room_characteristics: Formal ceremonial space with traditional Habsburg architectural design

gardensaal.description: Primary ground floor venue within the SnT2025 conference zone. Flexible exhibition and meeting space with direct access from entry foyer.
gardensaal.layout: Open exhibition space with flexible arrangements
gardensaal.door_details: Large doorway opening into exhibition space
gardensaal.room_characteristics: Flexible exhibition space with carpeted areas and adaptable layout
tactile_landmarks: Floor transition from marble to carpet

kiosk_reference_point.description: Information kiosk in Entry Foyer serves as primary navigation reference

clock_face_orientation.10_oclock: Red carpet area leading to Feststiege (10m)

feststiege_grand_staircase.location: 15m straight ahead from kiosk (12 o'clock direction)
feststiege_grand_staircase.description: Historic marble staircase with ornate balustrade

barrier_free_elevator_gardehalle.location: Far end of exhibition area, turn right, 15m ahead

barrier_free_elevator_seitenhalle.location: End of upper level corridor, right into Seitenhalle, 20m ahead
features: Same audio features as primary elevator

restrooms.location: Base of Feststiege stairs, turn right 5m
accessibility: Audible door locks in accessible stalls

prayer_room.location: Exhibition area entrance, immediate left 10m, first door
features: Quiet space for prayer and meditation

nursing_room.location: Exhibition area entrance, immediate left 10m, second door

evacuation_routes.ground_floor: Return to main entrance (6 o'clock from kiosk) or follow emergency audio beacons to secondary exits
evacuation_routes.upper_level: Feststiege grand staircase (primary) or emergency staircase in Seitenhalle (backup)

emergency_procedures.staff_identification: SnT2025 staff wear distinctive lanyards with tactile identification badges
